from pathlib import Path
import copy,hashlib,json,re,sys
P=Path(__file__).parent
def read(name):return json.loads((P/name).read_text())
def canon(x):return json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
def sha(x):return hashlib.sha256(x if isinstance(x,bytes) else x.encode()).hexdigest()
def ref(name):
 f=P/name;return {'path':str(f),'bytes':f.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(f.read_bytes())}
def save(name,x):(P/name).write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def q(x):return "'"+(x if isinstance(x,str) else canon(x)).replace("'","''")+"'"
def guard(expr,code):return " IF ("+expr+") IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '"+code+"' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;\n"
b=read('DB_BEFORE.json');old=json.loads(b['root']['canonical_preimage']);root=b['root']['revision_sha256']
assert root=='e3f3e222a3ad170f0dd7be648b3e81ce62c666c0295442e374a0bf2e529e5159' and sha(b['root']['canonical_preimage'])==root
edge=read('EDGE_BEFORE.json');assert edge['version']==94 and edge['verify_jwt'] is False and len(edge['files'])==14
ready=read('AUTHOR.json') # Deliberate owner freeze is required before producing a recipe.
assert ready['ready'] is True and ready['provider_calls']==0
assert ready['principles']=='general_editorial_guidance' and ready['scenario_specific_rules'] is False
files=[];changed=[]
for item in edge['files']:
 name=item['name'];base=(P/'baseline_edge'/name).read_bytes();candidate=(P/'candidate_edge'/name).read_bytes()
 assert base==item['content'].encode()
 files.append({'name':name,'bytes':len(candidate),'sha256':sha(candidate)})
 if candidate!=base:changed.append(name)
assert sorted(changed)==sorted(ready['changed_files']) and changed
for freeze in ready['sources']:
 assert sha((P/'baseline_edge'/freeze['name']).read_bytes())==freeze['before_sha256'] and sha((P/'candidate_edge'/freeze['name']).read_bytes())==freeze['after_sha256']
assert set(changed)<=set(['mission-generic-runtime.mjs','exam_regia17/edge/src/shared-scene/narrative-master.mjs'])
assert sorted(old['edge_bundles'][0]['files'],key=lambda x:x['name'])==sorted([{'name':x['name'],'bytes':len(x['content'].encode()),'sha256':sha(x['content'])} for x in edge['files']],key=lambda x:x['name'])
assert old['edge_bundles'][0]['version']==94 and old['edge_bundles'][0]['ezbr_sha256']==edge['ezbr_sha256']
recipe={'schema_version':'c1266-atmosphere-voice-integrated-recipe/1','baseline_root':root,'baseline_edge':94,'expected_edge':95,
 'changed_files':changed,'expected_files':files,'editorial_scope':'general principles within the existing Director/Writer cinematic route',
 'source_files':{name:ref('candidate_edge/'+name) for name in changed},'owner_freeze':ref('AUTHOR.json'),'builder':ref('BUILD_INTEGRATED.py'),'proofs':{name:ref(name) for name in ['STATIC.json']},
 'postflight_checker':ref('POSTFLIGHT_CHECK.py'),'db_baseline':ref('DB_BEFORE.json'),'scene_baseline':ref('EXTRA_BEFORE.json'),'git_baseline':read('GIT_BEFORE.json'),
 'zero_DDL':True,'zero_DB_header_changes':True,'zero_gameplay_or_provider_calls':True,'UI_and_LAND_unchanged':True,
 'preserved_config':['staff_finite_ia_budget','c1266_request_size_fix','all existing configuration except derived sha256'],
 'primary_review_unchanged':True,'G2_review_unchanged':True,'budget':{'minutes':90,'provider_calls':0,'browser_actions':0},
 'scene':{'session_id':'44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac','published_fato_unchanged':'e6dd8357-002e-4187-a72a-f1a5d900c0ad','protected_fields':48},
 'late_binding':['observed Edge95 exact fourteen source bytes and EZBR','independent reviewed recipe and builder ref/hash','Root SHA computed atomically in PostgreSQL'],
 'recovery':'No historical Root replay, receipt reset, scene restart or code-only Edge rollback. If a new work is active, defer installation; reconcile reviewed forward Edge/Root composition before provider work. Existing source, five published Fati, roles, cursor, audit, receipts and quota remain immutable.'}
mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'prepare'
if mode=='prepare':save('RECIPE.json',recipe);print(canon({'recipe':ref('RECIPE.json'),'status':'PREPARED_NOT_INSTALLABLE'}));raise SystemExit
assert recipe==read('RECIPE.json'),'Frozen recipe drift requires another aggregate review'
review=read('INTEGRATED_REVIEW.json');assert review['findings_count']=={'P0':0,'P1':0,'P2':0}
assert ref('RECIPE.json')['sha256'] in canon(review) and ref('BUILD_INTEGRATED.py')['sha256'] in canon(review)
review_ref=ref('INTEGRATED_REVIEW.json');observed=read('EDGE_AFTER.json')
assert observed['id']==edge['id'] and observed['version']==95 and observed['status']=='ACTIVE' and observed['verify_jwt'] is False
observed_files=[{'name':x['name'],'bytes':len(x['content'].encode()),'sha256':sha(x['content'])} for x in observed['files']]
assert sorted(files,key=lambda x:x['name'])==sorted(observed_files,key=lambda x:x['name'])
new=copy.deepcopy(old);new['edge_bundles'][0]={**old['edge_bundles'][0],'version':95,'ezbr_sha256':observed['ezbr_sha256'],'files':files}
new['config']['c1266_atmosphere_voice']={'schema_version':'c1266-atmosphere-voice-editorial/1','instruction_kind':'general_editorial_guidance',
 'route':'existing_cinematic_director_writer','source_review':review_ref,'integrated_recipe':ref('RECIPE.json'),
 'changed_files':{name:recipe['source_files'][name] for name in changed},'previous_release_sha256':root,
 'knowledge_unchanged':True,'world_rules_unchanged':True,'published_fati_unchanged':True,'provider_quality_test':'NOT_RUN'}
cfg=copy.deepcopy(new['config']);cfg.pop('sha256',None)
for key in ['c1266_clean_staff','c1266_staff_campaign']:
 for field in ['grant_id','not_before','expires_at']:cfg[key].pop(field,None)
cfg['c1266_opening'].pop('admission_not_before',None);new['config']['sha256']=sha(canon(cfg))
new['contract']['code_identity_sha256']=sha(canon({'db':new['db_core']['sha256'],'edge':new['edge_bundles'],'UI':new['ui'],'config':new['config']['sha256']}))
assert new['db_core']==old['db_core'] and new['ui']==old['ui'] and new['recovery']==old['recovery']
assert {k:v for k,v in new['config'].items() if k not in ['sha256','c1266_atmosphere_voice']}=={k:v for k,v in old['config'].items() if k not in ['sha256','c1266_atmosphere_voice']}
save('EXPECTED_ROOT.json',new)
query=(P/'BASELINE.sql').read_text().strip().rstrip(';');extra_query=(P/'EXTRA.sql').read_text().strip().rstrip(';')
expected={k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!='captured_at'};extra=read('EXTRA_BEFORE.json');assert extra['active_work_count']==0 and len(extra['fati'])==6
inflight="NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE state IN('claimed','authorized','provider_started')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts WHERE status IN('reserved','authorized','provider_started')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND state IN('ready','claimed','authorized','provider_started','uncertain'))"
s="""-- General NPC dialogue continuation editorial Edge95; metadata only. No DDL, enable, gameplay or provider action.
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL search_path TO pg_catalog,public,extensions;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5s';SET LOCAL statement_timeout='60s';
DO $npc_editorial_install$
DECLARE actual jsonb;expected jsonb;newpre jsonb;before_extra jsonb;after_extra jsonb;root_text text;root_sha text;n integer;
BEGIN
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('C1266:GENERIC-AI:AVAILABILITY',0));
 PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors WHERE master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid FOR UPDATE;
 PERFORM public.master_v2_lock_scope('44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid);
"""
for table in ['mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness','mission_factory_owner.c464_control','mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_runtime','mission_generic_owner.runtime_policy','mission_generic_owner.provider_policy','mission_generic_owner.flow_runtime_gate']:
 s+=f' PERFORM 1 FROM {table} WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;\n'
s+=' PERFORM 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_admissions ORDER BY actor_user FOR UPDATE;\n'+guard(inflight,'NPC_EDITORIAL_ACTIVE_WORK')
s+=' EXECUTE '+q(query)+' INTO actual;expected:='+q(expected)+'::jsonb;\n'+guard("(actual-'captured_at')=expected",'NPC_EDITORIAL_BASELINE_DRIFT')
s+=' EXECUTE '+q(extra_query)+' INTO before_extra;\n'+guard('before_extra='+q(extra)+'::jsonb','NPC_EDITORIAL_SCENE_DRIFT')
s+=' newpre:='+q(new)+'::jsonb;\n'+guard("newpre->'db_core'="+q(old['db_core'])+'::jsonb','NPC_EDITORIAL_DB_KEEP')+guard("newpre->'ui'="+q(old['ui'])+'::jsonb','NPC_EDITORIAL_UI_KEEP')
for key in ['staff_finite_ia_budget','c1266_request_size_fix','c1266_npc_dialogue','c1266_request_bytes_10x','c1266_turn_recovery','c1266_raw_input_recovery','c1266_saved_application_release']:
 s+=guard("newpre#>"+q('{config,'+key+'}')+'='+q(old['config'][key])+'::jsonb','NPC_EDITORIAL_HISTORICAL_QUALIFICATION_KEEP')
s+=" root_text:=newpre::text;\n"+guard('octet_length(root_text)<=262144','NPC_EDITORIAL_ROOT_SIZE')+" root_sha:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(root_text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');\n"
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness SET canonical_preimage=root_text,revision_sha256=root_sha,observed_revision_sha256=root_sha,client_build=\'mission-factory-admin/2:\'||root_sha,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton AND revision_sha256='+q(root)+';\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=1','NPC_EDITORIAL_ROOT_CAS')
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.c464_control SET release_sha256=root_sha WHERE singleton;\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=1','NPC_EDITORIAL_G2_CAS')
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_admissions SET release_sha256=root_sha WHERE actor_user IN('+','.join(q(a['actor_user']) for a in b['admissions'])+');\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=2','NPC_EDITORIAL_ADMISSIONS_CAS')
for path,expression in [('{root,canonical_preimage}','to_jsonb(root_text)'),('{root,revision_sha256}','to_jsonb(root_sha)'),('{root,observed_revision_sha256}','to_jsonb(root_sha)'),('{root,client_build}',"to_jsonb('mission-factory-admin/2:'||root_sha)"),('{g2,release_sha256}','to_jsonb(root_sha)')]:
 s+=' expected:=jsonb_set(expected,'+q(path)+','+expression+');\n'
for i in range(len(b['admissions'])):s+=' expected:=jsonb_set(expected,'+q('{admissions,'+str(i)+',release_sha256}')+',to_jsonb(root_sha));\n'
s+=' EXECUTE '+q(query)+' INTO actual;\n'+guard("((actual-'captured_at') #- '{root,updated_at}')=(expected #- '{root,updated_at}')",'NPC_EDITORIAL_ONLY_DECLARED_DIFF')
s+=' EXECUTE '+q(extra_query)+' INTO after_extra;\n'+guard('after_extra=before_extra','NPC_EDITORIAL_SCENE_KEEP')+guard(inflight,'NPC_EDITORIAL_ACTIVE_WORK_AFTER')
s+='END $npc_editorial_install$;\nCOMMIT;\n';(P/'INSTALL.sql').write_text(s)
save('BOUND_MANIFEST.json',{'recipe':ref('RECIPE.json'),'builder':ref('BUILD_INTEGRATED.py'),'installer':ref('INSTALL.sql'),'review':review_ref,'observed_edge':ref('EDGE_AFTER.json'),'metadata_only':True,'runtime_invoked':False,'primary_review_and_budget_unchanged':True})
print(canon({'installer':ref('INSTALL.sql'),'status':'BOUND_AWAITING_MATERIAL_REVIEW'}))

from pathlib import Path
import json,copy,hashlib
P=Path(__file__).parent
def read(n):return json.loads((P/n).read_text())
before=read('DB_BEFORE.json');after=read('DB_AFTER.json');old=json.loads(before['root']['canonical_preimage']);new=json.loads(after['root']['canonical_preimage']);extra=read('EXTRA_AFTER.json');checks={}
checks['exact_new_Root_tuple']=new==read('EXPECTED_ROOT.json')
checks['Root_SHA']=hashlib.sha256(after['root']['canonical_preimage'].encode()).hexdigest()==after['root']['revision_sha256']==after['root']['observed_revision_sha256']
checks['all_DB_headers_identical']=before['headers']==after['headers']
checks['all_scene_state_identical']=read('EXTRA_BEFORE.json')==extra
checks['six_Fati_preserved']=len(extra['fati'])==6
checks['zero_active_works']=extra['active_work_count']==0
checks['protected48_identical']=before['protected']==after['protected'] and after['protected']['protected_field_count']==48
checks['DB_UI_recovery_unchanged']=all(new[k]==old[k]for k in ['db_core','ui','recovery'])
checks['all_previous_config_identical']={k:v for k,v in new['config'].items()if k not in ['sha256','c1266_atmosphere_voice']}=={k:v for k,v in old['config'].items()if k not in ['sha256','c1266_atmosphere_voice']}
checks['primary_G2_review_unchanged']=before['root']['independent_review_ref']==after['root']['independent_review_ref'] and before['g2']['review_sha256']==after['g2']['review_sha256']
expected=copy.deepcopy(before);expected.pop('captured_at',None);actual=copy.deepcopy(after);actual.pop('captured_at',None)
for k in ['canonical_preimage','revision_sha256','observed_revision_sha256','client_build','updated_at']:expected['root'][k]=actual['root'][k]
expected['g2']['release_sha256']=actual['root']['revision_sha256']
for row in expected['admissions']:row['release_sha256']=actual['root']['revision_sha256']
checks['only_declared_metadata_changes']=expected==actual
report={'schema_version':'c1266-atmosphere-voice-postflight/1','status':'PASS'if all(checks.values())else'FAIL','checks':checks,'provider_calls':0,'editorial_quality':'NOT_QUALIFIED_BY_STATIC_OR_INSTALL_CHECK'}
(P/'POSTFLIGHT_CHECK.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report))
if not all(checks.values()):raise SystemExit(1)
